name: Platinum Vape Live Resin Disposable | Lemon Skunk
description: Bright, zesty, and uplifting—Platinum’s P1 All-In-One Lemon Skunk delivers bold citrus flavor with a classic skunky kick. Each hit bursts with tangy lemon and sweet herbal notes, followed by an energetic, euphoric high that keeps your mood lifted and your mind engaged. Pre-charged and disposable, the P1 makes it easy to enjoy this sativa favorite anytime, anywhere.
